captionStarter: Maryland reportedly ready to move on from Mike Locksley after a 54-3 loss to UCLA.
concept: Meme of the Week slide: Locksley's seat temperature graph spiking straight through the roof after the UCLA score
description: Multiple reports say Maryland is expected to fire head coach Mike Locksley after the Terrapins fell to 2-2 with a 54-3 loss to UCLA.
headline: Maryland reportedly ready to fire Mike Locksley
